messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete for release r2026.03.12 to service-inference-eu. Post-deploy checks started. KV probe alert: increased jitter on warmup path. <https://deploys.internal/release/r2026.03.12|deploy details>
anna: Noticed 95p latency on postdeploy kv probe jumped from ~120ms to ~560ms about 18s after rollout
miguel: Is this across all hosts or just warmup nodes? Could be prefix-cache storm or a throttle change
kevin k: Pulling synth logs now, sending snippet
kevin k: ```shell
[18:12:03] kvprobe warmup hit host-eu-12: 480ms
[18:12:03] kvprobe warmup miss rate: 82%
[18:12:04] prefix-cache fill triggered 1200 entries/sec
```
lina: Hmm that's consistent with warmup fanout. We staggered host warmup but the rollout batched ~50% at once
anna: Rollout was 45%->100% in 10m window per plan. Maybe autoscaler added bursty capacity right after
sre-oncall: Running a quick canary revert on a subset to compare behavior
sre-oncall: `kubectl set image deploy/inference=rl-2026.03.11 --namespace=eu -l rollout-group=canary` (ran)
miguel: Can we pin routing back to previous model variant for eu region until we confirm? @deploy-bot
anna: +1 pin routing. Also want a synthetic that exercises prefix-cache warm path (short TTL keys)
deploy-bot: Routing pin applied: model_variant=rl-2026.03.11 for namespace=eu (scope: 50% traffic) — <https://routing.internal/changes/871|details>
kevin k: Re-ran kvprobe after pin, 95p dropped to ~130ms
kevin k: ```shell
[18:15:20] kvprobe 95p: 132ms
[18:15:20] warmup miss: 12%
```
miguel: Looks like pin helped. Suggest we keep pin until we adjust warmup throttling and add pre-warm checks
lina: Action items: 1) revert warmup throttle change in rollout config 2) add pre-warm check into postdeploy target 3) add synthetic targeting prefix-cache warm path
anna: I'll open a PR with throttle rollback and include test reproducer and postdeploy notes
anna: PR: https://git.internal/repo/infra/rollouts/pull/439
sre-oncall: I'll keep monitoring; if metrics are stable for 15m I'll mark mitigated. Current plan: keep pin for EU and do a controlled redeploy in next change window
miguel: Agree. Marking for change window Tue 03:00 UTC and adding to release notes
deploy-bot: Post-deploy thread status updated: mitigated (routing pin active). Closing thread when SLOs stable. :white_check_mark:
